sonnet.problem: This story card retells Acts 9:15, the same verse that cards 6 and 7 just covered. It is mostly the answer to card 7 said back, plus 'their kings', and adds nothing new from the passage. It reads as a recap and a reaction to the question before it.
sonnet.rule: Every story card moves the baker forward through the passage. No recap cards.

sonnet.problem: The card says Ananias 'warned the Lord' about Saul. The text only says 'Ananias answered' and tells what he had heard (Acts 9:13-14). It never says he meant a warning. Calling it a warning also suggests the Lord needed to be told about Saul.
sonnet.rule: Call things what the text calls them. / Reasons: He never adds why someone did, said or thought something unless the text says why. / Nothing suggests God forgot someone.
